'''Twi'leks''', sometimes referred to [[xenophobia|xenophobically]] as '''tail-heads''' or '''Twi''', occasionally referred to as '''Rylothians''', were a tall [[near-human]] [[species]] whose most striking feature was a pair of long appendages protruding from their skulls, called [[lekku]]. They [[Homeworld|hailed]] from the [[planet]] of [[Ryloth]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], and [[Gender|female]] Twi'leks were often exported off world as [[Slavery|slaves]]. Twi'leks were considered one of the most common species in the [[galaxy]], with its members easily able to blend into a crowd without drawing attention, as opposed to rarer, more prominent species, like [[Togruta]]s. Some [[Army|armies]] used this to their advantage, employing Twi'leks as [[Spy|undercover agents]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Numa-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|Numa, a Twi'lek youngling]]
Twi'leks were a [[species]] of tall [[humanoid]]s whose skin spanned a vast array of [[color]]s,<ref name="Twi'lek Databank" /> including white,<ref name="Lyn Me" /> orange,<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> yellow,<ref name="Uprising" /> green,<ref name="RotJ" /> pink,<ref name="TD" /> blue,<ref name="Episode III" /> purple,<ref name="Commander" /> black, gray,<ref name="Tribes of Tatooine" /> and red.<ref name="Smuggler's Run" /> Their most distinctive feature was the pair of prehensile appendages that sprouted from the crown or base of their skulls,<ref name="Twi'lek Databank" /> known as [[lekku]], or head-tails. Although Twi'leks normally had two lek,<ref name="AbEverything" /> some individuals had four.<ref name="Episode III" /> Super sensitive lek could grab and hold objects and react to the slightest touch. A damaged lekku could cause serious harm to a Twi'lek's health.<ref name="AbEverything" />

The species had at least two [[Gender|sexes]], male and female. While most males typically had [[ear]]s with lobes resembling those of [[human]]s, some males had cone-shaped hearing organs located in the same place on the head,<ref name="Tribes of Tatooine" /> a trait customarily found in the females of the same species.<ref name="Rebels Recon 2.07">{{RebelsRecon|BqqeQEENm18|#2.07: Inside "Blood Sisters" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-blood-sisters}}</ref> Although Twi'leks naturally had blunt [[Tooth|teeth]],<ref name="Homecoming">{{Rebels|Homecoming}}</ref> males typically sharpened them into points.<ref name="LotS" />

Twi'leks were usually thin,<ref name="Twi'lek Databank" /> although corpulent individuals were known to exist.<ref name="Orn Free Taa">{{Databank|orn-free-taa|Orn Free Taa}}</ref> Under normal circumstances, they generally had a higher body [[temperature]] than other humanoid species.<ref name="Smuggler's Run" /> They had even higher body temperatures when in fear.<ref name="Much to learn">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-7-things-you-might-not-know-about-twileks|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: 7 Things You Might Not Know About Twi'leks}}</ref>

Twi'leks and humans could breed to create a [[hybrid]] of the two species: shortly after the [[Rescue of Hera Syndulla (Lothal)|death]] of [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Hera Syndulla]] gave birth to their [[Jacen Syndulla|son]], who appeared mostly human but inherited his mother's green pigment in his hair and ears. He was born after the [[liberation of Lothal]], in which Syndulla lived to participate.<ref name="Family Reunion – and Farewell">{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
[[File:Innocents_of_Ryloth.jpg|thumb|left|265px|Twi'leks skin spanned a vast array of color]]
The Twi'leks had a [[language]] of their own, called [[Twi'leki]], which combined verbal sounds and an elaborate, subtle sign language using their lekku. Twi'lek's lekku could be moved to create gestures with meanings such as hello or goodbye. For example, both lekku tips crossed twice meant, "I love you."<ref name="AbEverything" /> Twi'leks were capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard]], many with a noticeable accent; although it was possible for some to lose this accent if away from Ryloth for an extended period of time, it could still resurface. For example, Hera Syndulla lapsed back into the common Twi'leki accent during an argument with her father and also used it consciously when passing herself off as a slave.<ref name="Homecoming" /><ref name="Hera's Heroes">{{Rebels|Hera's Heroes}}</ref>

[[Mynock Cloud City]] and [[Mynock Coronet City]] were spicy [[Foodstuff|dishes]] made from [[mynock]]s that were popular with Twi'leks,<ref name="AbEverything" /> as well as a dish known as [[fried mynock]].<ref name="Survival Skills">''[[Star Wars: How Not to Get Eaten by Ewoks and Other Galactic Survival Skills]]''</ref> Twi'leks were [[Diet|eaten]] by [[gutkurr]]s,<ref name="AbEverything" /> vicious [[insect]] carnivores<ref name="VE" /> that used their sharp, curved [[claw]]s to snare their prey.<ref name="AbEverything" /> An integral part of Twi'lek culture and the familial clan was the [[Kalikori]], an heirloom based down through the generations, each of which would add to the totem. The Kalikori was only of value to the family from which it came from and was worthless to outsiders, who had no connection to that familial line.<ref name="Hera's Heroes" /> On the Twi'lek [[homeworld]] [[Ryloth]], Twi'leks celebrated the holiday called [[Longest Night]] when each of the [[planet]]'s three [[moon]]s were at their lowest phase. During this holiday, many would remain inside with their families as the populated hemisphere of the planet was covered in darkness.<ref name="Resistance Reborn" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|If we're here to free the tail-heads, the least they can do is get out of our way.|Boil|audio=GetOutOfOurWay-IoR.flac|<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" />}}
[[File:Aayla SWSB.png|thumb|250px|Aayla Secura served as a Jedi Master and General during the Clone Wars.]]
The homeworld of the Twi'leks was Ryloth, a [[planet]] of harsh extremes situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. That world was part of the [[Galactic Republic]], a democratic union that [[Politics|governed]] most of [[the galaxy]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], Ryloth was occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Unsatisfied with the tyrannical rule of the Confederacy, a [[Twi'lek Resistance]] movement arose, led by [[Cham Syndulla]], to [[Battle of Ryloth|combat]] the Separatists. This movement was publicly backed and actively assisted by the Galactic Republic. Working with the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order]], the Twi'lek Resistance managed to expel Separatist forces under [[Wat Tambor]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> The Republic then annexed Ryloth.<ref name="LotS" />

===Imperial protectorate===
Following the end of the Clone Wars, the Republic was transformed into the [[Galactic Empire]], and Ryloth was annexed by the Empire.<ref name="A New Dawn">[[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']]</ref> The planet became an Imperial [[Protectorate (government system)|protectorate]], and the Twi'leks living on Ryloth were subjected to Imperial rule. While Ryloth was nominally independent and was still represented by [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]] in the [[Galactic Senate]], real power lay in the hands of the Imperial [[Moff]] [[Delian Mors]].<ref name="LotS" />

About five years after the establishment of the Empire, Cham reorganized the Twi'lek Resistance as the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] in order to expel the Empire from Ryloth. While most of the Free Ryloth resistance fighters were Twi'leks, it included a number of non-Twi'leks such as [[Colonel]] [[Belkor Dray]]. The Free Ryloth resistance consisted of hundreds of fighters, a network of informants and [[Spy|spies]], and staged raids which led to the deaths of dozens of Imperial personnel. After [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] killed one of Cham's lieutenants, [[Pok (Twi'lek)|Pok]], and his comrades after the theft of an Imperial freighter from the [[Yaga Minor]] [[Yaga Minor shipyards|shipyards]], Cham decided to shift from half-hearted measures towards taking full action against the Empire.<ref name="LotS" />

[[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] conspired to lure the Free Ryloth rebels into a trap by organizing a visit to Ryloth with Darth Vader and arranging for information on the trip to be leaked to the Ryloth rebels. Cham seized the opportunity to kill the two [[Sith Lord]]s and fragment the Empire. The two Sith Lords traveled to Ryloth in the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Perilous]]''. Cham's rebels attacked the ''Perilous'' with space mines, [[Vulture-class starfighter|vulture droids]], and rebels disguised as rescue crew. However, Vader and the Emperor managed to escape to Ryloth. Following a prolonged pursuit, the Free Ryloth rebels tried to close in on the two Sith Lords in a remote village. Imperial forces under Moff Delian however arrived at the village and routed the rebels. Cham and his surviving comrades fled to resume their struggle.<ref name="LotS" />

[[File:HeraSyndulla-EmpireMagazine.png|thumb|left|220px|Hera Syndulla, rebel leader]]
Cham's daughter, Hera Syndulla, became a key leader in the rebellion against the Empire and led her own [[Spectres|rebel cell]]. She believed that Ryloth's freedom was linked to the rebellion. Hera disagreed with Cham's exclusive focus on Ryloth, and the two parted company. Three years before the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Empire used a [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]] to bomb Ryloth. Despite their differences, Cham and Hera's rebel cells joined forces to [[Mission to Ryloth (Phoenix Squadron)|steal]] the cruiser-carrier for the [[Phoenix Cell]]. As a result, ties were established between the Free Ryloth movement and the wider rebellion.<ref name="Homecoming" />

Two years before the Battle of Yavin, the Empire dispatched the [[Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] to deal with the Ryloth insurgency. By studying Twi'lek art, culture, philosophy, and history, Thrawn was able to devise successful tactics that led to the fall of [[Tann Province]]. The Free Ryloth movement lost many fighters, and Cham was forced to flee his [[Syndulla residence|own home]]. Hera, Cham, and the other rebels then took part in an [[Second mission to Ryloth|unsuccessful attempt]] to recover the [[Syndulla Kalikori]], a family heirloom, from Thrawn. Despite failing to recover the object, the rebels escaped an attempt by [[Captain]] [[Slavin]] to capture the rebels and Cham.<ref name="Hera's Heroes" /> Inspired by the Free Ryloth Movement and [[Phoenix Squadron]], many Twi'leks decided to fight against the Empire and join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to see peace in their homeworld.<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>

===New Republic Era===
In [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Life Debt Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> Ryloth was freed when Imperial forces on the planet abandoned their bases.<ref name="LD">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> After the rise of the [[First Order]], many Twi'leks feared an occupation of Ryloth would be inevitable, so they swore allegiance to [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] [[Resistance]],<ref name="Battlefront II" /> although the [[Ryloth government]] itself remained independent from her movement. However, the [[Ryloth Defense Authority]] arose as an unofficial faction on Ryloth dedicated to keeping the planet and its people safe. Shortly after the [[Battle of Crait]], Resistance forces sought refugee on Ryloth with the RDA until they were [[Attack on Ryloth|discovered]].<ref name="Resistance Reborn">''[[Resistance Reborn]]''</ref>

==Twi'leks in the galaxy==
[[File:TwilekFemaleServer-FromTheDesertComesAStranger.png|thumb|200px|A yellow-skinned Twi'lek female served in [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]].]]
Many Twi'leks were forced into a life of [[slavery]] at the hands of the galaxy's wealthy and powerful.<ref name="Twi'lek Databank" /> Other Twi'leks, however, found themselves in positions of power: [[Bib Fortuna]] served as the [[majordomo]] to the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]] for [[Standard decade|decades]],<ref name="Bib Fortuna">{{Databank|bib-fortuna|Bib Fortuna}}</ref> [[Aayla Secura]] and [[Finn Ertay]] were [[Jedi Knight]]s of the Jedi Order,<ref name="Aayla Secura">{{Databank|aayla-secura|Aayla Secura}}</ref> and [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]] represented his homeworld [[Ryloth]] in the Galactic Republic's Senate and later the [[Imperial Senate]].<ref name="Orn Free Taa" /> Due to their frequent use as slaves as well as their commonality in the galaxy, Twi'leks could move surreptitiously through places an army could not penetrate. Because of this, some found employment as undercover agents.<ref name="Infiltrator">''[[Star Wars: Uprising]]''—Crew Member: "Twi'lek Infiltrator"</ref>

Cham Syndulla was a leader of the Twi'lek Resistance during the Clone Wars<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> and later became the leader of the Free Ryloth movement.<ref name="LotS">''[[Lords of the Sith]]''</ref> His daughter Hera Syndulla was the leader of the Spectres<ref name="Spark of Rebellion">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''</ref> and was later promoted to [[Phoenix Leader]] in the Phoenix Squadron, eventually achieving the rank of General.<ref name="Wings of the Master">{{Rebels|Wings of the Master}}</ref><ref name="Rogue One: A Star Wars Story">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

During the Battle of Ryloth, the [[clone trooper]] [[Boil]] [[Xenophobia|derogatorily]] referred to the Twi'lek people as "tail-heads" as<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> he<ref name="Boil Databank">{{Databank|boil|Clone Trooper Boil}}</ref> complained of them constantly being in the way of his duty.<ref name="Innocents of Ryloth" /> During the [[New Republic Era]], the [[mercenary]] [[Migs Mayfeld]] derogatorily called [[Xi'an]]—who was a Twi'lek—a "crazy Twi"  after she thew a [[dagger]] at the chest of the [[New Republic officer]] [[Lant Davan]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 6: The Prisoner}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:HeraSyndulla.png|thumb|left|250px|Hera Syndulla in ''Star Wars Rebels'']]
Twi'leks first appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], directed by [[Richard Marquand]].<ref name="RotJ" /> The name "Twi'lek" was not spoken in any ''[[Star Wars]]'' film and was first mentioned by the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[1987]] [[West End Games]] publication ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="SWSB">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> The name was brought back to [[canon]] in the species' [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry.<ref name="Twi'lek Databank" />

The Twi'leks and their culture were more deeply explored in "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]" and "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]," episodes of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' animated series]]. During an interview with the ''Aggressive Negotiations'' podcast, ''Clone Wars'' writer [[Henry Gilroy]] stated that the species was chosen for the show for several reasons, including their recognizable appearance to viewers and the show's ability to use pre-made human assets for their character models. Gilroy also stated that one of the show's goals with the Ryloth arc was to change the perception of Twi'leks among fans. Citing characters such as Aayla Secura and [[Darth Talon]], Gilroy and fellow ''Clone Wars'' writer [[Dave Filoni]] felt that the species had too often been sexualized in their previous appearances, and so the two had discussions on how to portray the Twi'leks in a different light, leading to the development of characters like Cham Syndulla and, in ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', his daughter, Hera.<ref name="Henry Gilroy AG Pod">{{WebCite|url=https://www.spreaker.com/user/10684996/an-181#|text=Issue 181: Henry Gilroy: The Ryloth Arc|author=John Mills & Matthew Rushing|date=2019-09-20|format=Podcast|work=''Aggressive Negotiations: A Star Wars Pod''|archivedate=20200709073437}}</ref>
